lines.text: Bomb defusal in Retakes mode will now instantly finish when there is sufficient time remaining in the round and no active utility remains to prevent the defuse.
Reduced freeze time and round restart delay in Retakes mode.
Pinging pet chickens during freeze time will request a trick from them.
Pet chicken names are no longer displayed when customized item text game option is set to hidden.
Instance.Precache now accepts entities to precache
Added new top level export Entities
Moved Instance.ConnectOutput to Entities and changed it to accept a config object
Moved and renamed methods are still available in their original location, deprecated
Calling a method on an invalid (removed) Entity now reports that the Entity is invalid
ConnectOutput now logs a warning when the target has no output with that name
